detail: National monument 1003256 designates the Littlecote villa remains.
Identifies the separate villa by the Kennet and the modern timber cover over the excavated mosaic.
Excavation-era account describes the 41 by 25 ft room between the main remains and Kennet, half rectangular and half triconch, with a figured and geometric floor.
County archaeology record identifies the consolidated excavated structures and the surviving Orphic building.
The project account records the April 2026 shingle roof renewal and netting identified by the Friends of Littlecote Roman Villa, with factual text only.
